items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1962-01-31
items.q: Yeah, Tom Harris. Yeah, Tom Harris. Well, he wasn't much... I don't believe he had it two years when he died, you see. After he died, then I bought it.

ctx.x: You know, I used to go uptown to a place called... Thomas Beer Garden in 1945 and saw a bass player up there named Tom Harris. Remember that?

Yeah, Tom Harris. Yeah, Tom Harris. Well, he wasn't much. He wasn't that... I think that's the same bass that I've got now. It was brand new and he had been working out of Lincoln Beach. And the lady out there that was running Lincoln Beach, she stood for security for that bass. He bought that bass from White Island. It was brand new. And I don't believe he had it two years when he died, you see. After he died, then I bought it. His aunt.
Who was he playing out at Lincoln Beach with?
